units.source_text: 拉卟两只手捂住脸，默默地哭起来。

en.t: Rap covered his face with both hands and began to cry silently.

units.source_text: 我无疑非常同情他，同时想起了诗人托喀对河童家族制度的鄙夷态度。

en.t: I undoubtedly felt great sympathy for him, and at the same time remembered the poet Tokku's contempt for the kappa family system.

units.source_text: 我轻轻拍了拍拉卟的肩膀，尽力给他安慰：

en.t: I gently patted Rap on the shoulder and did my best to comfort him:

units.source_text: “这不是什么大不了的事儿，加油吧。”

en.t: "This is nothing so serious. Try to keep your spirits up."
